description: APPLICATION FOR THE TEMPORARY ERECTION OF 7 x PADEL COURTS AND ANCILLARY STRUCTURES.

open_spaces_details.description: Padel courts will be installed in the centre of the athletics track. Outdoor sports use will remain the use for the space.
open_spaces_details.open_space_type: Outdoor sports facilities incl. school playing fields

decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - Approved Plans - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: [02272-WEA- XX -XX-DR-A- 0003 Revision P04, 02272-WEA- XX- XX-DR-A- 2000 Revision P01, 02272-WEA- XX-XX-DR-A- 1000 Revision P04, 2272-WEA- XX -XX-DR-A- 0001 Revision P04, 02272-WEA- XX -XX-DR-A- 0002 Revision P03]

Condition : 3 - Materials as Specified - The facing materials to be used for the development hereby permitted shall be those specified in the application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - This planning permission is for a temporary time period only and shall apply to the use and associated structures only for the period 01 May 2026 to 30 April 2027, after which all structures shall be removed and the grassland area re-seeded and reinstated to its former condition. Construction of the structures hereby permitted can be carried out in the period up to 01 May 2026.

Reason: In the interests of the visual amenities of the Conservation Area and Registered Park, and having regard to Policies D12.3, D12.4 and D12.5 of the Local Plan 2024.
Condition : 5 - Cycle Parking  - Prior to first occupation, details of 20 temporary secure cycle parking facilities for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development shall be provided on site in accordance with pdf 'GR-PPT'. The approved facilities shall be fully implemented and made available for use prior to the first occupation of the development and thereafter retained for use at all times for the duration of the temporary planning permission.

Reason: To ensure satisfactory facilities for cycle parking are provided and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policy T5 of the London Plan 2021 and policy T16.1 and T16.2 of the Local Plan 2024.
Condition : 6 - Construction Vehicles - Prior to the commencement of above-ground installation, details of the provision to accommodate all site workers', visitors' and construction vehicles and loading /unloading arrangements during the construction process shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The approved details must be implemented and complied with for the duration of the construction process.

Reason: To ensure the safety of pedestrians and vehicles and the amenities of the surrounding area and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies T4 and T7 of the London Plan 2021 and policies T16.3 and T16.4 of the Local Plan 2024.
Condition : 7 - Construction Logistics Plan - Prior to the commencement of above-ground installation hereby permitted, including demolition, a Construction Logistics Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The approved measures shall be adhered to throughout the construction process, unless the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority is first obtained to any variation.

Reason: To ensure the safety of pedestrians and vehicles and the amenities of the surrounding area and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies T4 and T7 of the London Plan 2021 and policies T16.3 and T16.4 of the Local Plan 2024.
Condition : 8 - Bird boxes - Prior to the first occupation of the development, details of the provision of 1 x bird box and 1 x bat box as set out in the Preliminary Ecological Assessment Dated 11/07/25 shall  be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The agreed details shall be installed prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted and shall be retained thereafter.

Reason: to protect and enhance the biodiversity of the development in the interest of nature conservation and to comply with the following development plan policies for Merton: policies G5 and G6 of the London Plan 2021 and policy O15.3 of the Local Plan 2024.
Condition : 9 - Fire Strategy - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the provisions of the Planning Fire Safety Strategy prepared by Grass Roots Padel (Dated August 2025) and must fully comply with The Building Regulations 2010 (as amended) unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Reason: To ensure that the development incorporates the necessary fire safety measures in accordance with the Mayor's London Plan Policy D12.
Condition : 10 - Noise levels, (expressed as the equivalent continuous sound level) LAeq (1 Hour), from the use associated with the padel courts shall not exceed 50dB (1 hour) at the boundary with the closest residential property. If it exceeds this level then noise mitigation measures agreed with the Local Planning Authority shall be implemented to control any increase of noise above that predicted in the acoustic report. These mitigation measures shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, in consultation with Environmental Health.

Reason: In the interests of neighbouring amenity, in accordance with Policy D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.
Condition : 11 - The development hereby approved must be built and carried out in accordance with the Noise Management Plan Dated: 4th December 2025.

Reason: In the interests of neighbouring amenity, in accordance with Policy D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.
Condition : 12 - No new lighting shall be installed at the development hereby permitted. Existing athletics floodlights can be used and switched off by 21:00.

Reason: In the interests of the visual amenities of the Conservation Area and Registered Park, and neighbouring amenity, and having regard to Policies D12.3, D12.4 and D12.5 of the Local Plan 2024.
Condition : 13 - The recommendations set out in the Statement of Compliance Report Ref:  25-0573_C, Dated: 17/10/2025 must be fully complied with for the duration of the development hereby permitted.

Reason: To ensure the safety of all users of the Athletic Track.
Condition : 14 - When the padel courts, running track and associated activities are being used at the same time, the track shall be managed by members of staff  to ensure the safety of all users of the Athletics Track.

Reason: To ensure the safety of all users of the Athletic Track.
Condition : 15 - No fixed public-address (PA) or amplified sound system shall be operated on the site except for portable equipment used for coaching, safety announcements, or community events, and only when operated at a volume that does not cause undue disturbance to nearby residential properties. 

Reason: In the interests of neighbouring amenity, in accordance with Policy D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.
Condition : 16 - No construction deliveries shall take place in peak hours of 07.00 - 09.00 and 16.00 - 19.00 on any day.

Reason: To ensure the safety of pedestrians and vehicles and the neighbouring amenities of the surrounding area and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies T4 and T7 of the London Plan 2021 and policies T16.3, T16.4 and D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.
Condition : 17 - The padel courts and associated activities shall not operate outside Merton Council's opening and closing times for Wimbledon Park.

Reason: To ensure the safety of pedestrians and vehicles and the neighbouring amenities of the surrounding area and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies T4 and T7 of the London Plan 2021 and policies T16.3, T16.4 and D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.
Condition : 18 - Prior to the end of the time period as outlined under condition 4, the applicant must submit to the Local Planning Authority (LPA) a Landscape Management Plan. This will include details and a timeline of how the amenity grassland will be restored through light scarification, reseeding with an appropriate low maintenance amenity grass mix, and ongoing management (mowing and watering) to reinstate the baseline condition.
 
Reason: In the interests of the visual amenities of the Conservation Area and Registered Park, and having regard to Policies D12.3, D12.4 and D12.5 of the Local Plan 2024.
Condition : 19 - INFORMATIVE
Building Regulations 
Please note that this is a planning permission only and you may also require approval under the Building Regulations. If you are in any doubt about this you can get further information via https://www.merton.gov.uk/planning-and-buildings/building-control  or by emailing building.control@merton.gov.uk.

Condition : 20 - INFORMATIVE
You are advised to contact the Council's Highways team on 020 8545 3700 before undertaking any works within the Public Highway to obtain the necessary approvals and/or licences. Please be advised that there is a further charge for this work. If your application falls within a Controlled Parking Zone this has further costs involved and can delay the application by 6 to 12 months.
Condition : 21 - INFORMATIVE
Any works/events carried out either by, or at the behest of, the developer, whether they are located on, or affecting a prospectively maintainable highway, as defined under Section 87 of the New Roads and Street Works Act 1991, or on or affecting the public highway, shall be co-ordinated under the requirements of the New Roads and Street Works Act 1991 and the Traffic management Act 2004 and licensed accordingly in order to secure the expeditious movement of traffic by minimising disruption to users of the highway network in Merton. Any such works or events commissioned by the developer and particularly those involving the connection of any utility to the site, shall be co-ordinated by them in liaison with the London Borough of Merton, Network Coordinator, (telephone 020 8545 3976). This must take place at least one month in advance of the works and particularly to ensure that statutory undertaker connections/supplies to the site are co-ordinated to take place wherever possible at the same time.
Condition : 22 - INFORMATIVE
Note to Applicant -Approved Schemes
In accordance with paragraph 38 of the National Planning Policy Framework, London Borough of Merton (LBM) takes a positive and proactive approach to the delivery of sustainable development, by:
1. Providing a formal pre-application advice service, details to be found on Planning pre-application advice service on LBM's website
2. Providing written policies and guidance, which is available to view on LBM's website.
3. Where appropriate, negotiating amendments to secure a positive decision.
4. Determining applications in a timely manner including providing a fast track service, details to be found on Get a quicker planning decision on LBM's website.

In this instance:
i) The application was amended during the application process and was approved without delay.
